g.text: Quality levels against H, with WHO hearing-loss grades (approximate)

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: WHO grades are defined on the better-ear average of 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 kHz; H weights the bands differently, so the alignment is approximate.
